thread:
maya: Hey team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6123 is ready to merge but gated on the arch RFC. RFC: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/437 — it adds the multi-variant fallback routing rules. Can arch/runtime take a look? I left a short summary in the PR. TL;DR: we want to fallback to a smaller quantized model when latency >200ms.
sam: @maya grabbing it now :eyes:
michael: quick Q — RFC mentions 'priority routing by customer tier' — does that require config changes to smart-router? if so need migration plan.
maya: good catch. The change is opt-in per-service; default unchanged. Short snippet from RFC:
```yaml
routing:
  fallback:
    enabled: false
    threshold_ms: 200
```
We plan to set enabled: true for the canary.
tess: Runtime +1 on arch review after confirming KV cache behavior with quantized variant. Can we run perf test with a 2k seq? I can run perf on dedicated infra tomorrow.
arch-bot: RFC 437 status: awaiting architecture approval. Reviewer: @jules
jules: On it. Will review tonight; if perf numbers look good, can approve with canary condition.
maya: Thanks! I'll add a canary rollout plan in the PR and tag the perf artifacts. Plan: 10% traffic for 24h, auto-roll back on error rate >1% or latency p95 > 300ms.
sam: noted. If anything blocks merge we should create a follow-up ticket to avoid stalling prod fixes.
maya: Agreed. Will update PR with the rollout and add the perf links. :thumbsup:
